jobPostingInfo.title: LPN
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Pay Range:

$25.33 - $36.77

Care for our community, and your career.

·         Graduate from an accredited School of Nursing.   

·         Knowledge of new trends and techniques in Nursing. 

·         Current NYS LPN licensed or eligible. 

·         GPN’s must obtain NYS license within 3 months of hire. 

·         Current BLS certification required or obtained within 3 months of hire. 

Samaritan is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. Women, Minorities, Disabled, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.
